title: The dust floor is a fixed 1000 raw token units, so for a token with very few decimals a small whole position counts as dust

evidence.note: a balance at or under the threshold after a failed exit is torn down as a genuine close

evidence.ref: sed -n 612,623p of the base snapshot (22-27 merge)
evidence.note: Claude verification: lines re-read. Number recorded at TH-EXIT-10.

sibling_sites_checked: computeDustThreshold is the single source of the dust limit (exitEngine.ts:615). The unbounded basis-points setting is AUD-EXIT-016.
severity_rationale: S3: needs a token with 0 to a few decimals and a holding below 1000 raw units, which is rare at normal sizes. It would remove protection from a real position if it happened.
recommendation: Scale the absolute floor by token decimals, or use only the relative threshold. Phase 29 (S2-S4). Nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
